claim: Network Firewall also charges for traffic processed by the firewall endpoint, per GB per Region and Availability Zone, regardless of the traffic's source or destination; in US East (N. Virginia) it is $0.065 for 1 GB of data processed.

evidence.quote: You also pay for the amount of traffic processed by your firewall endpoint, billed by the gigabyte per region and Availability Zone. Data processing charges apply for each gigabyte processed through the firewall endpoint regardless of the traffic's source or destination.
Network Firewall Data Processing Charges: $0.065 for 1 GB of data processed by the firewall in US East (N. Virginia) per AZ.
